author: Karl Rock
description:
I was walking around Karachi when I noticed something strange… “Delhi Sweets.” In Pakistan. And it’s not just one shop — all over the city you’ll find places named after Indian cities like Delhi, Bombay, and more. So what’s going on here?

In this video, I step inside one of these sweet shops to find out:
- Why these names still exist,
- The history behind it,
- And what locals think about it today.

Along the way, we check out the food (of course), meet the people, and uncover a story that most tourists completely miss.

This is one of those small details that reveals a much bigger connection between India and Pakistan.
